purpose: Blind comparison of 2014-style geomorphon and frozen TinyMorphEncoder on true 4 m HiRISE Jezero versus new Earth geography
query_selection: Eight fixed lattice centers per scale, chosen from the saved HiRISE 3 km crop by DEM coverage only, without consulting Earth rankings or ground-truth labels. The 1 km windows overlap; treat their ratings as correlated.
earth_candidate_construction: Reproject each previously frozen USGS 3DEP 2 m holdout crop to the exact 4 m Mars comparison grid; use the existing candidates() stride and 55-D geomorphon signature, and frozen TinyMorphEncoder 32-D weights. Keep separate from the eight-site public development gallery and all model training.
retrieval: For each query and method, rank all heldout Earth windows by frozen descriptor. Shortlist global top 40, each site top 10, nearest 30 in P90-P10 relief, and nearest 5 per site. D4-align shortlisted elevations and rerank by median-centered physical-metre RMSE. Do not tune this rule from v8 labels.
candidate_selection: Choose two distinct windows from each reranked method, advancing over duplicates and requiring Earth centers at least one query width apart within a site. Add one site-stratified random control under the same separation. Shuffle five pairs by deterministic hash; keep method, rank, site, and offset only in a private answer key.
presentation: 24 Mars queries times five Earth pairs. Display 64x64 DEM hillshade at shared pair-relative height range and 8x visualization exaggeration. Hide geography and method until both independent ratings are sealed. Material and mission should be U unless reviewers have defensible independent evidence.
analysis: Two independent geoscience/remote-sensing reviewers score morphology, material, and mission 0-3/U. Report agreement, unknown rate, and within-five-judged-candidate nDCG@2 by 200/500/1000 m. Do not bootstrap by Mars reference site: only one HiRISE site exists. No global Recall@5, cross-body accuracy, or novel analog discovery claim.
limitations: Earth geography is held out but the Mars Jezero site and model design were previously used during development.
Only two Earth geographic holdout sites exist and adjacent candidate windows overlap strongly.
Lava Beds cave context and Pilot Valley salts are environmental facts not visible or labeled in surface DEM windows.
HiRISE post spacing does not prove 1 m rock resolution; Earth 3DEP sensing and Mars stereogrammetry have different errors.
No independent relevance ratings existed when this protocol was frozen.
